_comment: Model prices in USD per million tokens. This file OVERRIDES and EXTENDS the catalog shipped in src/pricing.js, and exists so the person paying the bill can correct a price or add a model without a code change. A model with no price here and none in the catalog is refused rather than treated as free, because a budget cannot be enforced against an unknown cost. cacheWrite defaults to 1.25x input and cacheRead to 0.1x input when omitted. "adaptive": false marks a model that takes no adaptive thinking and no effort (the catalog marks claude-haiku-4-5); neither is sent to it.
